dedupe_keys.name: dominican republic list of national monuments ministry of culture 2024

description: Ministerio de Cultura de la República Dominicana publishes the list of the National Monuments declared part of the cultural heritage of the Dominican Republic. Coverage: the Dominican Republic nationwide; the 2024 list, with the portal record created on 2023-09-11 and last modified on 2026-07-02. Format and access: ODS, CSV, XLSX, downloadable without registration from the Dominican open data portal (datos.gob.do); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL); cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the fields (for example location, type and declaration date) and the number of monuments are unconfirmed; it is a list, not a geospatial layer. Simulation uses: heritage-building exposure lists for hazard and climate-adaptation studies, and protected-asset constraints on rebuilding scenarios. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
